questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw bananas are imported into Japan in a single year?
reasoning: Japan has a population of approximately 125 million people
Each person consumes about 8 kilograms of bananas annually
Multiplying population by annual per capita consumption gives roughly one billion kilograms

questions.prompt: How many total individual piano keys are pressed across all pianos played by students taking grade-level piano exams administered by the Royal Conservatory of Music in Canada in a single year?
reasoning: About 100000 students take piano examinations annually in Canada
Each student practices for an average of 150 days per year
During practice, a student plays about 5000 notes per session, yielding roughly 500 million total key presses

questions.prompt: How many total individual domestic pet cats kept in households across Sweden climb scratching posts or furniture in a single day?
reasoning: Sweden has a domestic cat population of about 1.5 million animals
Eighty percent of these pet cats are active indoor or outdoor cats that interact with scratching surfaces daily
Multiplying the pet cat population by the active participation fraction yields 1.2 million cats
